item.stem:
Lila looks at the diagram. Straight lines $\ell$ and $m$ lie on the same flat page. Transversal $t$ meets them, and the marked corresponding angles are both $62^{\circ}$.

Which claim correctly decides whether $\ell$ and $m$ are parallel?

options.A: Call the answer the word transversal, and stop there.
options.B: Call $\ell$ and $m$ parallel even if they need not stay on the same flat page.
options.C: $\ell$ and $m$ are parallel: they lie on the same flat page and the equal corresponding angles from transversal $t$ show they do not meet when extended.
options.D: Call $\ell$ and $m$ parallel only because $62^{\circ}$ is the largest printed number in the diagram.
